pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with moderate pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the anterior flank (left) are larger and more irregular, while patches on the posterior flank (right) show a decrease in spatial area and more uniform rhomboidal shapes.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative space forms a continuous network of light pathways. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcations. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent throughout the visible regions, providing a high-contrast topological separation between dark patches.
